corrections.issue: By the quoted YTD numbers the trend index (-7.39%) was worse than the short-term traders index (-6.29%); the short-term index was 'by far the worst' only after scaling for its low volatility, and in August it fell 1.25% while the trend index rose almost 3%.
corrections.fix: In August 2025 the SG Short-Term Traders index fell 1.25% (-6.29% YTD) while the SG Trend index rose almost 3% (-7.39% YTD); because the short-term index runs at low volatility, on a volatility-adjusted basis it was by far the worst CTA sub-index, showing that speeds behaved very differently.
